37204.meaning2: Book 2 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya; Book on Causation

37205.meaningLit: canonical text of connected discourses, section on causation

37206.grammar: ind, adv, in comps, acc sg of nidāna
37206.meaning2: by means of, in consequence of
37206.commentary: (SNa) kāmahetū'ti kāmamūlakaṃ. kāmanidānan'ti kāmapaccayā. kām'ādhikaraṇan'ti kāmakāraṇā. sabbāni h'etāni aññam'aññavevacanān'eva.

examples.text: idh'āhaṃ, bhante, aḍḍakaraṇe nisinno passāmi khattiyamahāsāle'pi brāhmaṇamahāsāle'pi gahapatimahāsāle'pi aḍḍhe mahaddhane mahābhoge pahūtajātarūparajate pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇe pahūtadhanadhaññe kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsante.

37207.meaning1: recitation of the introduction; chanting of the synopsis

examples.text: nidān'uddeso niṭṭhitaṃ.

37211.meaning2: free from anguish, pain or fear
37211.commentary: (DHPa) niddaro hotī'ti tena ubhayarasapānena khīṇ'āsavo bhikkhu abbhantare rāgadarath'ādīnaṃ abhāvena niddaro c'eva nippāpo ca hoti.

examples.text: pavivekarasaṃ pitvā, rasaṃ upasamassa ca, niddaro hoti nippāpo, dhammapītirasaṃ pivaṃ.

37212.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of niddaratha, neg
37212.construction:
nir + √dar + a + tha + aṃ
niddaratha + aṃ

examples.text: nagarassa samīpe pavattati kathā iti upanagaraṃ, darathānaṃ abhāvo niddarathaṃ, makasānaṃ abhāvo nimmakasaṃ, vuḍḍhānaṃ paṭipāṭi yathāvuḍḍhaṃ

tena kho pana samayena tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam'antarākathā udapādi, yo hi koci, āvuso, dvādasavassāni paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati, niddaso bhikkhū'ti alaṃ vacanāyā'ti.

37214.commentary: (DNa) niddasavatthūnī'ti niddas'ādi-vatthūni. niddaso bhikkhu, nibbīso, nittiṃso, niccattālīso, nippaññāso bhikkhū'ti evaṃ vacanakāraṇāni. ayaṃ kira pañho titthiyasamaye uppanno. titthiyā hi dasavassakāle mataṃ nigaṇṭhaṃ niddaso'ti vadanti. so kira puna dasavasso na hoti. na kevalañ'ca dasavasso'va. navavasso'pi… ekavasso'pi na hoti. eten'eva nayena vīsativass'ādi-kāle'pi mataṃ nibbīso, nittiṃso, niccattālīso, nippaññāso'ti vadanti.

examples.text: satta niddasavatthūni. idh'āvuso, bhikkhu sikkhāsamādāne tibbacchando hoti, āyatiñ'ca sikkhāsamādāne avigatapemo.

37216.meaning2: term of praise for an ascetic; (not ten ? without ten ? more than ten?; not in a (conventional) stage of life?)

examples.text: uṭṭhahatha nisīdatha, ko attho supitena vo, āturānañ'hi kā niddā, sallaviddhāna ruppataṃ.
niddaṃ na bahulīkareyya, jāgariyaṃ bhajeyya ātāpī, tandiṃ māyaṃ hassaṃ khiḍḍaṃ, methunaṃ vippajahe savibhūsaṃ.

37219.meaning1: getting rid of sleep and fatigue; removing sleepiness and tiredness

examples.text: so kho ahaṃ, bhante, aññatr'eva asitapītakhāyitasāyitā aññatra uccārapassāvakammā aññatra niddākilamathapaṭivinodanā vassasat'āyuko vassasatajīvī vassasataṃ gantvā appatvā'va lokassa antaṃ antarā'y'eva kālaṅ'kato.

37221.meaning2: waking up at the end of sleep

examples.text: nandanā nandati c'eva, natthiputtasamena ca, khattiyo saṇamāno ca, niddātandī ca dukkaraṃ, hirī kuṭikā navamo, dasamo vutto samiddhinā'ti.

37224.commentary: (SNPa) niddānan'ti chedanaṃ lunanaṃ uppāṭanaṃ, karaṇ'atthe c'etaṃ upayogavacanaṃ veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: kāyagutto vacīgutto, āhāre udare yato, saccaṃ karomi niddānaṃ, soraccaṃ me pamocanaṃ.

37225.meaningLit: to cause to be cut down

examples.text: mandiyā nu kho sesi udāhu kāveyyamatto, atthā nu te sampacurā na santi, eko vivitte sayan'āsanamhi, niddāmukho kim'idaṃ soppase vā'ti.

dhammassavan'agge pana nisīditvā niddāyanto c'eva nānappakārañ'ca niratthakakathaṃ kathento dhamme agāravo viharati nāma. saṅghamajjhe bāhāvikkhepakaṃ nānattakathaṃ kathento theranavamajjhimesu ca cittīkāraṃ akaronto saṅghe agāravo viharati nāma.
seyyathā'pi nāma sakaṃ khettaṃ ohāya paraṃ khettaṃ niddāyitabbaṃ maññeyya, evaṃ sampadam'idaṃ pāpakaṃ lobhadhammaṃ vadāmi, kiñ'hi paro parassa karissatī'ti.
middhī yadā hoti mahagghaso ca, niddāyitā samparivattasāyī, mahāvarāho'va nivāpapuṭṭho, punappunaṃ gabbham'upeti mando.

37235.meaning1: taking pleasure in sleep; addicted to sleep

examples.text: idh'āvuso, bhikkhu kamm'ārāmo hoti kammarato kamm'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, bhass'ārāmo hoti bhassarato bhass'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, nidd'ārāmo hoti niddārato nidd'ārāmataṃ anuyutto

37236.meaning1: enjoying sleep; taking pleasure in sleep

examples.text: idh'āvuso, bhikkhu kamm'ārāmo hoti kammarato kamm'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, bhass'ārāmo hoti bhassarato bhass'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, nidd'ārāmo hoti niddārato nidd'ārāmataṃ anuyutto

idha, bhikkhave, sekho bhikkhu kamm'ārāmo hoti, kammarato, kamm'ārāmatam'anuyutto, bhass'ārāmo hoti, bhassarato, bhass'ārāmatam'anuyutto, nidd'ārāmo hoti, niddārato, nidd'ārāmatam'anuyutto. ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattanti.

37238.meaning1: pleasure of sleep; enjoyment of dozing
37238.meaning2: pleasure of sleep; enjoyment of sleep; lit. enjoying sleep state

examples.text: na kamm'ārāmatā, na bhass'ārāmatā, na nidd'ārāmatā, na saṅgaṇik'ārāmatā, indriyesu guttadvāratā, bhojane mattaññutā, asaṃsagg'ārāmatā, nippapañc'ārāmatā.

37239.meaning2: fond of sleep, of drowsy habits

37240.meaning1: habitually sleeping; sleepy by nature; fond of sleep
37240.meaning2: fond of sleep, of drowsy habits

examples.text: niddāsīlī sabhāsīlī, anuṭṭhātā ca yo naro, alaso kodhapaññāṇo, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.
dhātuniddiṭṭhehi paccayehi kh'ādikārit'antehi vibhattiyo honti. titikkhati, jigucchati, vīmaṃsati, samuddāyati, puttīyati, kāreti, pāceti.

yañ'ca, cunda, rattiṃ tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhati, yañ'ca rattiṃ anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyati, yaṃ etasmiṃ antare bhāsati lapati niddisati. sabbaṃ taṃ tath'eva hoti no aññathā, tasmā tathāgato'ti vuccati.

so ce dūto taṃ veyyāvaccakaraṃ saññāpetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya, yaṃ kho, bhante, āyasmā veyyāvaccakaraṃ niddisi, saññatto so mayā, upasaṅkamat'āyasmā kālena, cīvarena taṃ acchādessatī'ti.

37247.meaning1: should be indicated; should be pointed out; should be designated; should be appointed (by)

examples.text: so ce dūto taṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadeyya, atthi pan'āyasmato koci veyyāvaccakaro'ti. cīvar'atthikena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā veyyāvaccakaro niddisitabbo ārāmiko vā upāsako vā, eso kho, āvuso, bhikkhūnaṃ veyyāvaccakaro'ti.

37248.meaning2: should be explained, should be defined

37250.meaning2: having pointed out, having explained, having defined

37251.commentary: (DNt) sā pana nesaṃ marisaniyasampattikatā dukkhavirahitāyāti vuttaṃ niddukkhā'ti'pi vuttaṃ hotī'ti.

examples.text: app'ābādho'ti arogo. app'ātaṅko'ti niddukkho. samavepākiniyā'ti samavipācanīyā.

37255.meaning1: Book 14 and 15 of the Khuddaka Nikāya; Mahāniddesa and Cūḷaniddesa

examples.text: tato paraṃ jātakaṃ, niddeso, paṭisambhidāmaggo, apadānaṃ, suttanipāto, khuddakapāṭho, dhammapadaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, vimānavatthu, petavatthu, theragāthā, therīgāthā'ti imaṃ tantiṃ saṅgāyitvā khuddakagantho nām'āyan'ti ca vatvā abhidhammapiṭakasmiṃ'y'eva saṅgahaṃ āropayiṃsū'ti dīghabhāṇakā vadanti.
so karohi dīpam'attano, khippaṃ vāyama paṇḍito bhava, niddhantamalo anaṅgaṇo, dibbaṃ ariyabhūmiṃ upehisi.
taṃ hoti jātarūpaṃ dhantaṃ sandhantaṃ niddhantaṃ aniddhantaṃ anihitaṃ aninnītakasāvaṃ, na c'eva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ, na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca, na ca sammā upeti kammāya.

37262.meaning1: with impurities removed; purged of dross
37262.commentary: (ANa) aniddhantakasāvan'ti anīhatadosaṃ anapanītakasāvaṃ. (SNPa) niddhantakasāvamoho'ti ettha rāg'ādayo tayo, kāyaduccarit'ādīni ca tīṇī'ti cha dhammā yathāsambhavaṃ appasann'aṭṭhena sakabhāvaṃ vijahāpetvā parabhāvaṃ gaṇhāpanaṭṭhena kasaṭ'aṭṭhena ca kasāvā'ti veditabbā.

examples.text: taṃ hoti jātarūpaṃ dhantaṃ sandhantaṃ niddhantaṃ niddhantakasāvaṃ, mudu ca hoti kammaniyañ'ca pabhassarañ'ca, na ca pabhaṅgu, sammā upeti kammāya.
nillolupo nikkuho nippipāso, nimmakkho niddhantakasāvamoho, nirāsayo sabbaloke bhavitvā, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

37263.meaning2: with impurity and delusion got rid of

examples.text: so karohi dīpam'attano, khippaṃ vāyama paṇḍito bhava, niddhantamalo anaṅgaṇo, dibbaṃ ariyabhūmiṃ upehisi.

37265.meaning1: blows off; removes by blowing; purifies

examples.text: anupubbena medhāvī, thokaṃ thokaṃ khaṇe khaṇe, kammāro rajatass'eva, niddhame malam'attano.
tam'enaṃ suvaṇṇakāro vā suvaṇṇakār'antevāsī vā jātarūpaṃ mūsāyaṃ pakkhipitvā dhamati sandhamati niddhamati.
na hatthaniddhunakaṃ bhuñjissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, pabbajalāyako pabbajaṃ lāyitvā agge gahetvā odhunāti niddhunāti nicchoṭeti
anāpatti asañcicca, assatiyā, ajānantassa, gilānassa, kacavaraṃ chaḍḍento hatthaṃ niddhunāti, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

te taṃ saṅkhaṃ avakujjaṃ nipātesuṃ, passena nipātesuṃ, dutiyena passena nipātesuṃ, uddhaṃ ṭhapesuṃ, omuddhakaṃ ṭhapesuṃ, pāṇinā ākoṭesuṃ, leḍḍunā ākoṭesuṃ, daṇḍena ākoṭesuṃ, satthena ākoṭesuṃ, odhuniṃsu sandhuniṃsu niddhuniṃsu, vadehi, bho saṅkha, vadehi, bho saṅkhā'ti.

37288.meaning1: washes off; cleans off; rinses away

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, jātarūpassa oḷārikā upakkilesā paṃsuvālukā sakkharakaṭhalā. tam'enaṃ paṃsudhovako vā paṃsudhovak'antevāsī vā doṇiyaṃ ākiritvā dhovati sandhovati niddhovati.

37290.synonym: ādhāna, ādhāra, upadhāna, paṭiggaha, piṭhara, pīṭhara

examples.text: kathaṃ aparipakkato? so pan'āyam'āhāro evarūpe okāse nidhānam'upagato yāva aparipakko hoti, tāva tasmiññ'eva yathāvuttappakāre paramandhakāratimise nānākuṇapa-gandhavāsita-pavanavicarite atiduggandhajegucche padese

37292.meaning2: good, skillful at laying by, storing; keeping

37293.meaning1: arrived in the receptacle; come to the container

examples.text: kathaṃ aparipakkato? so pan'āyam'āhāro evarūpe okāse nidhānam'upagato yāva aparipakko hoti, tāva tasmiññ'eva yathāvuttappakāre paramandhakāratimise nānākuṇapa-gandhavāsita-pavanavicarite atiduggandhajegucche padese

37294.meaning1: worth treasuring; worth recording; worth keeping in the heart
37294.commentary: (ANa) nidhānaṃ vuccati ṭhapan'okāso, nidhānam'assā atthī'ti nidhānavatī, hadaye nidhātabba yuttavācaṃ bhāsitā'ti attho.

examples.text: kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ

37296.meaning1: deposits; stores; places for safekeeping; keeps

examples.text: ekena bhoge bhuñjeyya, dvīhi kammaṃ payojaye, catutthañ'ca nidhāpeyya, āpadāsu bhavissatī'ti.
alaṅ'kato ce'pi samaṃ careyya, santo danto niyato brahmacārī, sabbesu bhūtesu nidhāya daṇḍaṃ, so brāhmaṇo so samaṇo sa bhikkhu.
nidhāya daṇḍaṃ bhūtesu, tasesu thāvaresu ca, yo na hanti na ghāteti, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
kadā iṇ'aṭṭo'va daliddako nidhiṃ, ārādhayitvā dhanikehi pīḷito, tuṭṭho bhavissaṃ adhigamma sāsanaṃ, mah'esino taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
nidhīnaṃ'va pavattāraṃ, yaṃ passe vajjadassinaṃ, niggayhavādiṃ medhāviṃ, tādisaṃ paṇḍitaṃ bhaje, tādisaṃ bhajamānassa, seyyo hoti na pāpiyo.
